response.sql: WITH spatial_projects AS (SELECT p.fundflux, s.boxx, s.boxy, s.aream2, s.volm3 FROM scanspatial s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry), funding_stats AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG((boxy - boxx) / boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, AVG(aream2 / volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM spatial_projects WHERE boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxx != 0 AND boxy IS NOT NULL AND aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 != 0 GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_diff, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_stats) AS above_average FROM funding_stats WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_stats) ORDER BY area_to_volume_ratio DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Area-to-volume ratio for each funding source is the average of per-record ratios AVG(aream2 / volm3), not the ratio of sums SUM(aream2) / SUM(volm3).
Records where boxx = 0 or volm3 = 0 are excluded to prevent division by zero, treating these as data quality issues rather than valid measurements.

alternatives.interpretation: Area-to-volume ratio could be calculated per funding source as the ratio of aggregated totals: SUM(aream2) / SUM(volm3), rather than the average of individual record ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH spatial_projects AS (SELECT p.fundflux, s.boxx, s.boxy, s.aream2, s.volm3 FROM scanspatial s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry), funding_stats AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG((boxy - boxx) / boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM spatial_projects WHERE boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxx != 0 AND boxy IS NOT NULL AND aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 != 0 GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_diff, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_stats) AS above_average FROM funding_stats WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) FROM funding_stats) ORDER BY area_to_volume_ratio DESC;
